sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior applicability complement and inclusive tolerance repair. In the per-loading-condition outcome alternatives, make the residualStabilityFactorSI tolerance branch conditional on alternativeInstrumentApplicable being false (or otherwise not applicable); currently a case with alternativeInstrumentApplicable=true can pass through the residual-factor branch without alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus=true. Retain the alternative branch requiring applicability=true and compliant status.
